title: celastrus senegalensis var. europaeus
intro: Celastrus senegalensis var. europaeus, commonly known as the Schisandra europaea or Schisandra chinensis var. europaea, is a plant species in the Schisandraceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, which include improving cognitive function, enhancing immune system function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, enhance the immune response, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Celastrus senegalensis var. europaeus include schisandrins, schisantherins, and other lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
